title: Recovery help for Lahaina commercial property owners
summary: At the latest meeting, a testifier said Lahaina town remains largely unbuilt since the August 2023 fires and that it is time to rebuild downtown so people have jobs. In August, a property owner said he plans an 18,000-square-foot building for businesses that lost their places, and that the parcel, part heavy industrial and part agricultural, needs a change for parking. Hundreds of businesses still need places to reopen, and no commercial property has been rebuilt and occupied.

timeline.text: The testifier said people need jobs and it is time to rebuild downtown Lahaina.
A testifier said Lahaina town remains largely unbuilt since the August 2023 fires.
He said he plans an 18,000-square-foot building for businesses that lost their places in the fire.
The owner confirmed the parcel is part heavy industrial and part agricultural, and the change is needed for parking space.
The property owner said hundreds of Lahaina businesses still need places to reopen.
A commercial property owner said no commercial property in Lahaina has been rebuilt and occupied since the fire.
